source: HMRC Real Time Information via ONS — Payrolled employments in the UK by nationality, region and industrial sector, July 2014 to December 2024 (Table 1: monthly counts of UK payrolled employments by nationality). Joined with DWP Stat-Xplore NINo flow rolling year ending Q4 2025.
caveat: HMRC RTI counts EMPLOYMENTS not employees — one person with two jobs is counted twice. The series excludes self-employed, students, dependants and the inactive. 47 nationalities are published; smaller cohorts (Eritrea, Sudan, Iraq, Afghanistan and many others) are aggregated into UK / EU / Non-EU rollups only. National granularity only at this level — there is no LA-level RTI by nationality. NINo flow and HMRC payroll are different concepts and should not be summed.
